mappings.key_fact: Enterprise customer (Meridian Retail Group) paused orders and migrated replenishment volume to competitor (SwiftKart) due to three of five June deliveries missing SLA; this represents direct loss of conversion/order volume from a high-value account.
Enterprise customer (Kalinga Mart) renewal at risk and evaluating competitor express program after June delivery misses on 4 POs, indicating imminent conversion loss in the North-West region.

WH-07 conveyor failure on June 25 reduced North-West throughput to ~60% and created staffing shortage; ops team forecasted SLA breaches on North-West lanes, which directly preceded the July conversion rate decline.
By July 3, WH-07 backlog reached 1,900 orders with oldest at 5 days; manual sortation holding at 60%; complaint volume climbing with late delivery as primary driver.
Consumer order promised in 2 days delivered in 6 days due to WH-07 dispatch delay; customer requested refund, indicating service failure converting to churn/non-repeat conversion.

new_hypothesis.label: North-West warehouse operational failure in late June caused SLA breaches that triggered enterprise customer churn and reduced consumer repeat conversions in July
